title: pkg/api: createImage checkpoint query parameter is missing from swagger docs
body:
The POST `/libpod/containers/{name}/checkpoint` endpoint accepts a createImage query parameter — the handler (`pkg/api/handlers/libpod/containers.go`) decodes CreateImage string (`schema:"createImage"`) and uses it (`CreateImage: query.CreateImage`), backing podman container checkpoint `--create-image` ... but the `ContainerCheckpointLibpod` swagger definition (`pkg/api/server/register_containers.go`) documents every other checkpoint query param (keep, leaveRunning, tcpEstablished, export, ignoreRootFS, ignoreVolumes, preCheckpoint, withPrevious, fileLocks, printStats) except `createImage` so API consumers can not discover it. Add the missing param ... 
*docs-only no behavior change*
